proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.lifecycle_override
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can already grant Scrying, fixed-DC Detect Thoughts, and sensor-origin targeting, but it cannot override Detect Thoughts to require no concentration while making that granted cast end when the linked Scrying ends.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends."

notes: Stopped before authoring content because a plain grant_spell_access encoding would be dishonest: it would incorrectly require concentration on Detect Thoughts and let it persist independently of Scrying.
